name: Plumb Stance
description: Stand on the plumb line of the school with the weight true so that the guard holds against a push.

name: Rule Strike
description: Strike with the school's rule of the open palm so the blow follows a fixed true line.

name: Plumb Walk
description: Advance on the plumb line in a straight steady pace that keeps the body upright and ready.

name: Rule Hold
description: Hold a foe's arm along the school's rule so the limb stays rigid and straight.

name: Plumb Thrust
description: Drive a thrust along the plumb line of the target's balance to pierce the centre.

name: Plumb Ward
description: Turn a strike down the plumb line of the body and let it run harmlessly into the ground.

name: Rule Crush
description: Bring the rule down in a crushing blow that splits a guard along its weakest line.

name: Plumb Prison
description: Fix a foe in place with lines of qi dropped from above until it cannot raise a hand.

name: Judgment Descending
description: Let the rule fall in full upon one foe so it is struck down and held beneath that weight.

name: Rule Unbroken
description: The school move that sets the rule upon a foe so that none of its blows or techniques may break it.

name: Ledger Stance
description: Take the school's ledger stance and enter each blow against the guard as it is received.

name: Entry Fist
description: Strike a fist into the foe and enter the blow in the school ledger as a debt.

name: Entry Step
description: Take a step to a set place on the line where the next entry will be made.

name: Credit Mark
description: Mark the force given by the school to the user as credit and spend it on a later strike.

name: Debit Strike
description: Strike with the sum owed by the foe so the blow lands with every earlier hit added.

name: Page Guard
description: Turn a leaf of the guard against a blow and send its force back to the account of the sender.

name: Cancel Debt
description: Cancel a lien or curse on an ally by striking its entry from the book.

name: Audit Blow
description: Deliver a blow weighted by the full sum of the school ledger against that one foe.

name: Account Seal
description: Seal the foe's account so that it cannot gain or draw any further force for a time.

name: Ledger Reckoning
description: Call every entry of the school ledger due in one wide blow upon the debtors in reach.

name: Ledger Closed
description: The school move that closes the ledger on a foe and strikes it with all that it owes at once.

name: Domain Stance
description: Take the school's stance and draw the domain close about the body as a plain steady ward.

name: Decree Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries the school's decree into the foe's chest.

name: Decree Pace
description: Pace across the domain where the ground itself is laid out to receive the step.

name: Domain Sight
description: Know every body and every force within the domain as it enters and as it moves.

name: Compliance Wave
description: Send a wave of order that presses foes in the domain to stillness for a breath.

name: Ordained Shield
description: Hold a shield by the school's decree over the user and the allies standing beside them.

name: Proclaimed Mend
description: Proclaim an ally whole and let the order of their body pull their wounds shut.

name: Rule Lance
description: Loose a lance of ordained qi that pierces every body in a straight line across the domain.

name: Edict of Silence
description: Decree silence upon a chosen kind of technique so none of that kind can be cast in the domain.

name: Domain Crush
description: Bear the whole weight of the domain down on one area in a crushing pulse.

name: Domain Law
description: Make the school's decree the law of the whole domain so foes fail and allies stand guarded.

name: Decree Absolute
description: The school move that issues the decree in full so that foes in the domain are struck down at once.

name: Pattern Stance
description: Take a stance that matches the school's pattern and spreads force across the whole body evenly.

name: Core Palm
description: Strike with a palm driven from the core outward along the unbroken line of the pattern.

name: Patterned Stride
description: Step along the pattern so each move of the body falls in the same order as the last.

name: Held Pattern
description: Hold the pattern firm at the core so heavy blows cannot disturb it.

name: Pattern Mend
description: Pass the pattern into an ally's core and set right the flaws that curses or deviation left.

name: Core Drive
description: Drive qi from the formed core out through the palm in a single ordered and heavy blow.

name: Pattern Lock
description: Lock a foe's own qi into a pattern of the user's making so it moves only as shown.

name: Unwritten Hand
description: Unwrite the pattern of a gathered technique with one touch so it comes undone before use.

name: Pattern Fortress
description: Build a fortress of ordered qi from the core that stands whole against a barrage of strikes.

name: Sealed Pattern
description: Seal the pattern so that no technique of the foe can alter or break the user's form.

name: Pattern Eternal
description: The school move that fixes the user's pattern so it holds against all unmaking while it stands.

name: Even Parry
description: Meet a strike with an open even palm and turn it aside along its own line.

name: Balanced Strike
description: Strike with a hand set at the point where the foe's guard and balance are equally weak.

name: Poised Step
description: Step with the weight kept dead level so the user can turn at once in either direction.

name: Level Eye
description: Read at a glance which of two foes stands stronger and by how much.

name: Flattening Press
description: Press down on a strong foe's qi until it falls to match the user's own output.

name: Lift the Weak
description: Raise an ally's qi toward the user's own so that the gap between them narrows.

name: Level Return
description: Return a blow to its sender in exactly the measure it came with by the turn of an even hand.

name: Hand of Parity
description: Touch a foe and strip from its technique every edge it holds above the common measure.

name: Balance Break
description: Break a foe's balance with one level push so that its whole stance topples.

name: Wide Level
description: Sweep an even hand outward and flatten the stance of every foe within its reach.

name: Perfect Parity
description: Level every fighter in a wide ring to the same strength under the even hand.

name: Level Hand
description: The school move that sets the even hand on a foe and strikes down all strength above the common measure.

name: Inked Palm
description: Strike with a palm that leaves a faint first line of the school's seal upon the foe.

name: Marked Guard
description: Inscribe a plain seal upon the guard to harden it against a single heavy blow.

name: Script Step
description: Step in the motion of a drawn stroke so that each pace finishes a clean line.

name: Second Stroke
description: Add a second line to the seal on a foe so that it cannot draw on one of its channels.

name: Binding Script
description: Write a binding script across a foe's limbs that tightens each time the foe pulls against it.

name: Erase Mark
description: Rub out a hostile seal or curse inscribed on an ally and let their qi run free again.

name: Triple Seal
description: Inscribe three seals together upon a foe so that three separate channels close at once.

name: Seal Burst
description: Break a stored seal so that its bound force bursts outward and strikes all around it.

name: Closing Stroke
description: Draw the closing line across a great foe so every seal on it locks and its strength fails.

name: Last Seal
description: The school move that sets the last and binding seal so that a foe's power is closed away.

name: Dominion Stance
description: Take the stance of the dominion and let its level ground rise to meet the user's feet.

name: Level Fist
description: Strike with a fist whose qi is held exactly level with the foe's own force.

name: Even Walk
description: Walk the dominion's even floor in plain steady paces with nothing to catch the foot.

name: Dominion Mark
description: Mark every body that crosses the dominion's edge and learn its strength at once.

name: Flattening Wave
description: Send a wave across the floor of the dominion that flattens stance and footing together.

name: Level Mercy
description: Draw an ally's injuries level with their healthy flesh until the wounds sink and close.

name: Strength Cap
description: Cap the strength of all foes in the dominion at one common limit for as long as it holds.

name: Equal Weight
description: Set an equal weight on every foe in the dominion so each moves as slowly as the next.

name: Dominion Strike
description: Strike the floor and send a leveling shock through the whole dominion at once.

name: Rule of Equals
description: Hold the dominion to a rule of equals so foes sink to a common level and allies rise to it.

name: Dominion Level
description: The school move that levels the whole dominion so that nothing within may rise above the rule.

name: Statute Stance
description: Take the stance of the final statute and stand fixed upon its first article.

name: Article Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries one article of the statute into the foe.

name: Clause Pace
description: Pace out the clauses of the statute with each step set exactly in its place.

name: Appeal Denied
description: Deny the claim of an incoming technique and let no trace of it pass the guard.

name: Ruling Strike
description: Strike with a blow that rules the exchange at an end and leaves no room for reply.

name: Pardon Qi
description: Pardon an ally of a curse or taint laid upon them and strike its terms from their qi.

name: Verdict Seal
description: Pass a binding verdict that seals one foe's technique and its motion together.

name: Edict Bar
description: Raise a wall that holds as law and cannot be crossed by any technique that the statute bars.

name: Statute Absolute
description: Make the statute absolute over a wide space so banned techniques fail before they form.

name: Final Statute
description: The school move that proclaims the final statute and brings its sentence down on one foe.
